plays/client-workspace-launch.md.title: Stand up a new client workspace

client-workspace-launch.title: Stand up a new client workspace
client-workspace-launch.label: Client workspace launch
client-workspace-launch.summary: Give a new client their own workspace, profile and plays in about an hour.
client-workspace-launch.prompt: Set up a separate workspace for my new client from their brief and website: fill in their company profile, add their positioning, and install the plays that fit them. Keep my own workspace as it is.
trigger_phrases: Onboard a new client into Oxygen
Set up a workspace for a new client
How do I run Oxygen for multiple clients?
Stand up a client account from scratch
Repeatable client onboarding for my agency
client-workspace-launch.business_case: Every new client means the same setup from scratch. One workspace per client, filled from their website and brief, billed to your plan, with the plays they will run installed as pages, makes onboarding a repeatable hour and keeps each client's data, senders and spend apart.
client-workspace-launch.outcome: A separate client workspace you are switched into, billed to your plan under a monthly cap, with the client's profile (OXYGEN's free website research plus the brief), a positioning page, three installed plays, and the first paid step quoted.
client-workspace-launch.leading_metric: time from a signed client to a working workspace with profile, positioning and installed plays
client-workspace-launch.benchmark: A clean launch is 30-60 minutes of free setup; the first paid step, a 25-lead pilot, follows in the client's workspace once the client agrees its cap.

effort.time_to_value: client workspace ready the same session

credits.pilot: 0 (OXYGEN pays the one-time research of the client's website)
credits.full: 0 for the launch; a first 25-lead pilot about 125; each client mailbox 100 a month

prerequisites.detail: A user key that can switch workspaces; a workspace-bound key can neither create nor switch
Credits in your own workspace for the client's paid work (the launch itself is free on any plan)
The client's website (or its LinkedIn company page if it has none) and their brief: what they sell, to whom, and who never to contact
